## About
Corvette Masters is a Corvette shop on West Marvin Avenue in Longwood, Florida. We handle scheduled maintenance and repairs on Corvettes, and we do performance work on Corvettes, GM muscle cars and hot rods.
Our ASE certified technicians take on jobs big and small, from an oil change or a troubleshooting visit to a rebuilt classic engine or a road racing chassis setup. We also honor extended warranty plans.
We hold a 4.6 rating from 101 Google reviews. Give us a call to set up an appointment.

## Services
- Scheduled maintenance and repairs: Corvette service, scheduled maintenance and repairs, from classics to current models.
- Professional installation: Parts installed correctly and with attention to detail, from a crank pulley change to a rear end gear installation or a full competition race engine.
- Engine building: We can rebuild your classic to factory specifications or build a competition race engine, or anything in between.
- Chassis setups for road racing: Complete chassis setups built and installed for road racing, plus custom roll bar and roll cage design, fabrication and installation.
- Performance work: Suspension, engine swaps, superchargers, turbos, nitrous, transmission swaps, exhaust, tuning and dyno work for Corvettes, muscle cars and hot rods.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you work with extended warranty plans?
A: Yes. We provide service for extended warranty plans.

Q: Do you work on cars other than Corvettes?
A: Our performance work also covers muscle cars and hot rods, including tuning, engine swaps and suspension.

## What customers say
- "From the street level, you can easily drive right on by and never see the entrance. Even as you enter the short paved roadway, nothing jumps out and says this is what you have been searching for until you pass the gate.

The people working here are not mechanics in a normal sense. They are professional Corvette mechanics. Their parking lot and garage is overfilled with every rendition of this class and iconic car. And only Corvettes.

There are no 2003 Ford Taurus with the hood open trying to get it running so the kids can be picked up from soccer practice. You will not find the workers sitting around telling war stories over a pot of coffee. These are Vettes in every year, type, and configuration. They will be tuned and repaired to wherever you want it to be at.

I brought in my 1969 Mako Shark edition for a comprehensive evaluation and maintenance. My goal was to ensure it was safe to drive and ready to go. It belonged to a great friend who passed away and although it was garage kept, it ran poorly and looked in need of some serious overhaul.

George the service manager asked me a thoughtful and honest question: what did I want the car to do? I knew that lots of work ahead would be coming but I wanted it to be safe, fast, and continue to be a head turner. He explained that they approach each vehicle one at a time. First up was a comprehensive assessment and timeline.

The assessment answered many questions for me. Yes, it’s in great condition. Yes, it’s 50+ years old and many components are original and need replacement. And it will take time. Let me clear, this isn’t a 10-minute oil change place but the workmanship is worth the time and money. From the original projected quite, they were within $100.

I waited my turn to be repaired. It felt like forever but every customer I met there said the same thing, when you leave it’ll be perfect. Juan is one of their trusted employees, a hard diligent worker that made me feel at ease. Robby, the owner, is a true gear head who helped me see the great potential in my car and even added some nice touches that really charge my heart.

I am not a rich person who brought them one of my Vettes from my home collection. I am a normal Joe who always coveted one. If you have a Corvette in Central Florida and you need some work, this is the place to go. Mind you they are busy and don’t have someone always answering the phones although some times you’ll get Bob, a regular guy who is retired and likes hanging out at the shop.

And if you see a fat, bearded man in a souped up 69 convertible Corvette Stingray, Mako Shark edition, with scoop baffles, 4 on the floor, Hurst shifter, positrac rear with 3.70 gearing, headers and dual exhaust burning up the road. That’ll be me thanks to Robby, George, Juan, and Bob at Corvette Masters." (Mike Hilliard, 5/5)

They took the time to show me my brakes and rotors and explain what they were looking at and how they were making their decisions. They even took the car on a test drive to ensure that it was safe to drive and did not need any brake work.
